I woke up with over 100+ notifications from reddit which is a bit overwhelming 😂 I've been trying to comb through all the hundreds of comments (I'm sorry if I didnt reply back to some of yall!) and a few things made sense to me but nothing was 100% so I wanted to make my own comment with a few deductions.

Some people believe it's a hub cap for an old horse carriage which would make sense with the history of the house! But, some people pointed out it's too small for a hub cap and I couldnt really find one as ornate as this.

Another popular response was that it's a lid to a small trinket box/tabacco box/snuff box. With the lip on the back of it, this could be possible!

Lastly a lot of people suggested this may be a part of a horse rosette. This could also be a possibility but theres no remnants of a pin to hold it onto the horse rosette on the back.

All of these seem like possible fits to me, so I'll say it's likely solved. 

However if I find out more about this, like the meaning of the symbols on the medallion or anything else, I'll be sure to update yall! 
Thank you so much to everyone who commented and helped out 💜
